runner_decision_checklist.headline: What to know before you head to Cornelia Fort.
runner_decision_checklist.intro: A quick runner checklist for pickup, parking, and what to bring before race morning.

items.label: Packet pickup
items.value: Bring photo ID for packet pickup
items.detail: Schedule owns the pickup times; use this checklist to remember the photo ID requirement and pickup locations.

items.label: Parking
items.detail: Parking is free at Friday pickup and race morning, with carpooling or ride shares strongly encouraged because parking is limited.

items.label: Hydration
items.detail: RunSignup states hydration will be available in the start/finish area and on the half marathon course; course hydration is subject to change.

items.label: Half Marathon ages
items.detail: RunSignup lists the Tom King Classic Half Marathon as open to ages 4–95.

story.title: Celebrating 31 years of racing in Nashville.
paragraphs: Celebrating its 31st year, the Tom King Classic invites runners to join a familiar Nashville race morning at Cornelia Fort Airpark.
The event keeps the tone simple and welcoming: choose the Half Marathon or 5K Run/Walk, bring photo ID for packet pickup, and celebrate your accomplishment with post-race food and awards.
Both distances are part of the Nashville Striders 2026 Grand Prix Race Series, with the combined field limited to 600 participants because of parking limitations.

uncertainty.summary: Visible public sources confirm date, location, distances, course language, route links, field cap, schedule, registration status, shirts, general post-race food/awards, parking, hydration, age eligibility, contact form, and refund policy. Current entry prices were not visible because online registration is closed. Exact awards ceremony times were not confirmed in the source material and are intentionally not published in the schedule. Facebook public search confirmed the page exists and describes the race as an annual Nashville half marathon and 5K, but Facebook content was not used for page facts because it was login-gated in browser.

items.reason: RunSignup Event Info shows online registration closed and does not expose current prices in the visible public page state.
The source describes certified courses but no certification number was visible in the captured public pages.
No public race photo gallery with clear reuse rights was found, so the private mockup uses a generated hero image instead of copying photos.
